task: Deliver Phase 3F authenticated avatar upload as one API PR stacked on PR #44.
acceptanceCriteria: PUT /api/user/avatar accepts one authenticated multipart avatar upload and returns the serialized user with a private file URL.
Only JPEG, PNG, and WebP signatures are accepted, and uploads are limited to 2 MiB.
Avatar replacement serializes per-user updates and retries stale attachment cleanup on a later upload.
Authentication, upload validation, storage failure compensation, and API contract have focused unit and E2E coverage.
blastRadius: private attachment metadata and storage cleanup
contracts: GET /api/files/:id is deferred to the next stack PR
